column3: Close to the Hebrew; “on a scroll from the mouth of Jeremiah” is rendered “in a book at the instruction of Jeremiah.”
Close to the Hebrew; “I am weary with my groaning” is rendered “I fainted in my sighing.”
Close to the Hebrew; “all the land, it” is rendered “that is, this whole land.”
NKJV turns the statement “you are seeking great things” into a question, “And do you seek great things for yourself?”; “calamity” is rendered “adversity,” and “as plunder” “as a prize.”
